\bar{x}=\frac{1-21-21-18+8}{5}=-\frac{51}{5}
\]

The sum of squared deviations is

\[
\left(\frac{56}{5}\right)^2+\left(-\frac{54}{5}\right)^2+\left(-\frac{54}{5}\right)^2+\left(-\frac{39}{5}\right)^2+\left(\frac{91}{5}\right)^2
=\frac{18770}{25}
\]

The sample variance is

\[
s^2=\frac{1}{5-1}\cdot \frac{18770}{25}=\frac{1877}{10}
\]

So the sample standard deviation is

\[
\boxed{\sqrt{\frac{1877}{10}}}
\]
